title: Evidence registry entry
description: One entry in 06-EVIDENCE/evidence.yaml. Maturity must not exceed what the artifact field can actually substantiate (Section 33-35) — Claude may never author an E5 entry (no self-declared AUDITED).

maturity.description: E5 must never be set by Claude itself — it requires an external audit record.

artifact.description: Repository-relative path to the real file/log/report this entry points to.

produced_by.description: Command or CI job that generated the artifact, e.g. 'npm test' or a GitHub Actions job name.

audit_record.description: Required when maturity is E5_INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED — points to the external audit record, e.g. a Codex review file.
